output.business: The record returned by the service

marqeta_card_state_changed_trigger.description: Runs when one of the cardholder's cards is activated, suspended, terminated or otherwise changes state.

output.card: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: The cardholder whose cards to watch.

marqeta_new_business_trigger.description: Runs when a business is created in the program.

output.business: The record returned by the service

marqeta_new_card_trigger.description: Runs when a card is issued to the cardholder.

output.card: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: The cardholder whose cards to watch.
parameters.name: user_token

marqeta_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs when a transaction is recorded in the program, such as a card authorization, a clearing or a funding.

parameters.description: Only this cardholder's transactions. Leave empty for the whole program.
parameters.name: user_token

marqeta_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when a cardholder (user) is created in the program.

output.cardholder: The record returned by the service

marqeta_transaction_declined_trigger.description: Runs when a card transaction is declined.

output.transaction: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only this cardholder's transactions. Leave empty for the whole program.
